_notes: Vanilla entities touching blocks, recorded by the asset generator's capture-scenarios (ScenarioContactCaptures.cs) on a headless vanilla server in a void world, whose game is frozen and stepped one tick at a time, with random ticks, mob spawning and weather off. Coordinates are absolute. Setup blocks are placed first, live, in order, with neighbour updates (/setblock). Each tick t from 1 to the scenario's ticks: its entity events happen first, at the previous game time, then the game advances one tick. An event summons an entity of a type at a position (an item holding `item`, with a pickup delay that never runs out; a mob with `noAi`; with `noGravity`, for an entity the events move a step each tick; with `motion` as its starting velocity), teleports one (`move`), removes one (`remove`: moved far below and killed, so it leaves at once), or kills one in place (`kill`: a mob then dies as usual, staying in the level for its death animation). Checkpoints hold the box after each tick (checkpoint 0 after setup): one string per (y, z) row, y then z ascending, with a character per x giving the block's palette index in 0-9a-zA-Z; palette states are full states with every property, sorted by name. `entities` holds where each of the scenario's entities still in the level is, by tag.
